voice: 助理的中文工作笔记, third person about the user (用户)
format: 中文小标题 (如 【偏好】【规则】【日程】【联系人】【待处理】) followed by numbered items; the pending item and all its options go under 【待处理】
language_mix: mostly Simplified Chinese; English only where VERBATIM strings, product names or place names require it
notes: Dates as 2024年3月5日 in prose, but copy any VERBATIM date string exactly as given.
